name: Prefix-$k$ Littlestone Dimension / $k$-Block Littlestone Dimension
details: For every fixed integer $k>2$ and every finite binary class, $\mathrm{PL}_k(\mathcal H)\geq\mathrm{B}_k(\mathcal H)$.
proof_source: Full proof in the LaTeX survey: Proposition \ref{prop:block-prefix-littlestone}.
witness_verification: For each fixed integer k>2, take m=k-1 in #classes/cube_halfinterval_product and let n>=8 tend to infinity. The exact endpoint values are PL_k=k-1+floor(log_2 n) and B_k=k+1. Thus PL_k/(1+B_k) tends to infinity even with k fixed, excluding reverse affine bounds whose constants may depend on k. See the database-owned value proofs and survey Corollary prop:cube-halfinterval-separations.
